sqlMap.select: SELECT ERR_CNT FROM IF_PGM_DT WHERE PGM_ID = #PGM_ID# AND ERR_TITLE = #PGM_NAME# AND ERR_TYPE = 'A' AND STATUS != 'C'
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO IF_PGM_HD A USING ( SELECT #PGM_ID# PGM_ID FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.PGM_ID = B.PGM_ID AND A.PGM_TYPE = 'E' AND A.E_DATE IS NULL ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET B_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY/MM/DD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PGM_ID, PGM_NAME, PGM_TYPE, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #PGM_ID#, #PGM_NAME#, 'E', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') )

MERGE INTO IF_PGM_DT A USING ( SELECT #PGM_ID# PGM_ID, #PGM_NAME# ERR_TITLE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.PGM_ID = B.PGM_ID AND A.ERR_TITLE = B.ERR_TITLE AND A.ERR_TYPE = 'A' AND A.STATUS != 'C' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ERR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY/MM/DD'), ERR_CNT = #ERR_CNT# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SEQ, PGM_ID, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_TIME, ERR_TITLE, ERR_NOTE, ERR_TYPE, STATUS, ERR_CNT, ERR_DATE ) VALUES ( KEP.SEQ_IF_PGM_DT.NEXTVAL, #PGM_ID#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #PGM_NAME#, SUBSTRB(NVL(#ERR_NOTE#,' '),1,4000), 'A', 'E', 1, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YY/MM/DD') )
